entry.title: Kamala Harris: ”Ska göra allt i min makt för att besegra Trump”

entry.title: ”Thomas” misstänktes för mordet på Bussaba Carlsson

När en man häktades misstänkt för mordet 2023 fick fallet stor uppmärksamhet. Hans DNA hittades nämligen på Bussaba Carlssons kropp. Men det fanns ytterligare en potentiell mördare.

entry.title: Jupiter’s upper atmosphere surprises astronomers
entry.summary: Using the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope, scientists observed the region above Jupiter’s iconic Great Red Spot to discover a variety of previously unseen features. The region, previously believed to be unremarkable in nature, hosts a variety of intricate structures and activity.

entry.title: So Your Website Or App Is Live… Now What?
entry.summary: The biggest mistake you can make in UX design is to launch a website or app and then walk away. Monitoring and improving after launch will benefit users and your metrics. Nothing will bring bigger gains.
